'''Star Tours Flight 604''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Telerath/Legends|Telerath]]. On the day of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]], it was on time and set to arrive at Gate 2D at 1815 hours. It was scheduled to depart again at 1910.
